label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: the insecure randomness source 'new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)' feeds 'rememberMeKey' which is used as a session token in a cookie. Alert 2 (java/xss) is TP: user-provided cookie value flows through 'param' to the HTML response sink in the 'else' block where it's printed directly without encoding. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths.

evidence.note: Insecure random number generator used to create rememberMeKey
User-provided cookie value flows to HTML response sink without encoding
